method: derive supplemental OpenAlex keyword routes from explicit-quantum topic works
selection_notes: Counts use unique Swedish-affiliated works from the verified 1950-2026 topic routes.
The topic universe is the deduplicated set reached by all non-blocked topic routes.
Explicit share is the fraction of topic-universe works carrying a keyword that were also reached by at least one explicit_quantum topic.
High-confidence keywords pass the 20-work, 2-topic, and 80% explicit-share thresholds and are accepted automatically outside the configured domain safeguard.

The title-confirmed tier passes the lower 10-work, 2-topic, and 70% explicit-share thresholds, but a retrieved work is included through this route only when its own title independently matches a quantum pattern.
Both the keyword display name and normalized keyword ID must independently match a quantum-specific paper pattern from sweden_quantum_paper_filter.json in either tier.
No manually enumerated keyword or text-query allowlist is used.
